_why: Registry rows that exist for BEAM-LABEL RESOLUTION, not for the grid. The beam stash's `source` labels are normalised short forms, and nine of them resolved to no registry row; these eight have a base already registered or a publisher card naming one, so the descent edge is a match rather than an assertion. They are NOT on the v3 roster and must never be counted as coverage.
_the_defect_this_file_fixes: These eight were appended to data/model_registry.json AFTER the producer ran, so they carried only {model_id, family, stage} and none of the status fields. Three tests failed on KeyError 'status' / 'in_grid_spec'. Rebuilding would have DELETED them, because scripts/build_model_registry.py builds 112 rows from its own sources and had no way to learn about these. A population that enters an artifact by a path the producer does not know is a population the producer will silently drop.
_provenance: Authored by @lacan; recorded in model_registry.json _provenance under beam_label_gaps_2368 (5, bases already registered) and beam_label_gaps_cards_2375 (3, sourced from publisher model cards fetched 2026-08-01). This file DECLARES them so a rebuild preserves them; it does not add to or subtract from that list.

_held_deliberately_not_here.01-ai/Yi-9B: card says 'continuously trained based on Yi-6B'; Yi-6B unregistered and the card does not state whether Yi-9B shares a pretraining run with the registered Yi-1.5-9B. Merging collapses two lineages, splitting invents one.
